hook: Old City Metro: *833* of 888 properties already acquired
hook_b: Old City Metro: *833* of 888 properties already acquired
tldr: Prep work on the 7.5-km Darulshifa–Chandrayangutta Metro is speeding up: utilities are being mapped, and civil works tenders are expected late Nov or early Dec.

beats.what: Officials are probing water pipelines, drainage lines and service connections to shift them before digging begins.
beats.why: Road widening and Metro works need 888 properties; over Rs 800 crore has been paid to owners so far.
beats.care: Expect phased demolitions and possible traffic changes along the Old City stretch in the coming weeks.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today: 833 properties acquired, ~55 left. Tenders for pillars and elevated corridor due late Nov/early Dec; MGBS–Chandrayangutta construction targeted to start in January.

facts.t: Compensation of *over Rs 800 crore* has already been paid to property owners.

viz.verdict: 55 left, some of them heritage structures
Old City commuters: phased demolitions before work starts

watch: Civil works tenders expected late November or early December; construction targeted for January.

sources.title: Preparatory works gather pace for Darulshifa-Chandrayangutta Metro corridor

fact: Old City Metro has *833 of 888* properties acquired; construction targeted for January.
